name: negation
description: Per-pin negation (negInputs/negOutputs) on the flat kinds, the generic kernels, the power-on seeding and wired-OR. Input comp0 pins: a=link0, b=link1, clk=link2, nh=link3 (negated output: rests high from tick 1), s=link4, r=link5. Flat kinds: NOT with a negated output (a buffer on a single-driver link whose rest seed and init cancel) -> link6; DELAY with a negated input (rests high) -> link7; NAND (AND2, negated output) -> link8; XNOR (XOR2, negated input a) -> link9; a|!b (OR2, negated input b) -> link10; half adder with negated a and negated carry -> links 11/12; full adder (a, b, s) with negated sum -> links 13/14; D flip-flop with a negated clock (falling-edge) -> links 15/16. Generic kernels: NOR3 (3-input AND, all inputs negated) -> link17; JK (J=a, K=b) with a negated Q -> links 18/19; SR with a negated S (S reads high while s is low; the edge at tick 19 with r high enters the invalid state, the one at 25 leaves it) -> links 20/21; CLK (period 1) halted by its negated halt pin on nh: frozen at power-on, running once nh rises on tick 1, frozen again while nh is written true at ticks 22-27 -> link22; RNG with a negated trigger (draws at power-on and on falling clk edges) -> links 23/24; DEC with a negated a (rests on output 1) -> links 25-28; MUX (select a, data !s / r) -> link29; RAM (address a, data b, WE nh, negated clock: writes on falling clk edges; the one at tick 16 stores 1 at address 1, the one at 22 is blocked by nh) -> link30. Wired-OR: a NOT of a and a NAND of a, b drive link31 (invalid while they disagree, a=1 b=0). Cross-coupled NOR latch (OR2s with negated outputs, s/r on links 4/5, q=link32, qbar=link33): both rest high, oscillate until s is written at tick 4, then hold until r at tick 19.
